info.name: insurance-claims-api-claims-internet - Non-Regression Tests
info.description:
Generated non-regression collection for the internet-facing claims API.

Derived from:
- OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification: insurance-claims-api-claims-internet
- ACE 12 implementation evidence from insurance-claims-integration-claims and downstream technical flows

Observed runtime relation chain:
- insurance-claims-api-claims-internet (APIC internet API)
- -> insurance-claims-integration-claims (/insurance-claims/v2/routing)
- -> GET /claim, POST /find, GET /health route to insurance-claims-integration-technical-idit
- -> POST /claim validates and routes asynchronously to MQ, then to insurance-claims-integration-technical-idit or insurance-claims-integration-technical-alis
- -> downstream side effects include EDM metadata update and claim email notification

Important execution notes:
- Set url-apic-external, url-oauth2-access-token and client credentials before running
- POST /claim is asynchronous and 202 only confirms acceptance/queueing, not business completion
- For executable tests, set collection variables starting with mustProvide_*

Reachable email address used by downstream flows
Existing grouped document guid when number-of-documents > 0
Existing document uuid referenced under document-list-guuid

item.name: 📁 TCSCH
item.description:
Consumer-specific tests for TCSCH.

ACE routing rule observed in insurance-claims-integration-claims:
- TCSCH does not force ALIS
- Destination for POST /claim is determined by product-code and damage-code rules
- Product-code 105 is routed to IDIT and triggers extra bike-specific validation

item.name: OK - Create claim routed to IDIT

request.description:
TCSCH claim submission designed to satisfy IDIT-side routing validations using product-code 105 and bike-specific data.

ACE findings:
- product-code 105 routes to IDIT
- IDIT destination requires event.description, primary-cause-of-loss-extcode, event.location.country-code, event.location.type-desc, informant personal-id, e-mail, language FR/DE/IT, personal-reference and document-list consistency
